name: Manchego
siboNotes: Aged hard cheeses like Manchego are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated in SIBO diets. The aging process removes most problematic sugars.
preparationTips: Choose aged Manchego (12+ months) for lowest lactose content
Pair with low-FODMAP crackers or gluten-free bread
Grate over salads or low-FODMAP pasta dishes
Store properly wrapped to maintain flavor and texture
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in calcium for bone health
